_proposer_meta.fy_context: Call is early Q1 FY27 (FY26 ended 31-Mar-2026). near = through Q4 FY27; medium = FY28 / 2028; long = 2030+.
_proposer_meta.note: HIGH-RECALL PROPOSAL ONLY — not final ground truth. Union with the GPT-5.5 output, then human-adjudicate every item against the PDF. No explicit forward revenue figure exists in this call (management declined), so credibility_scorable is almost always false.

candidates.passage: The first phase of expansion having 3,60,000 ton per annum of stainless steel capacity remain on track for commissioning in quarter four, financial year 2027.
